general_rules.encoding: UTF-8 (a UTF-8 byte-order mark is accepted); other encodings are rejected
general_rules.format: delimited text, first line = header, delimiter from data.delimiter (default ',')
general_rules.identifiers: exact strings; empty values and leading/trailing spaces are errors (ABP-E105)
general_rules.missing_values: tokens listed in data.missing_values (default '', 'NA', '.') mean 'not measured'; ABP never imputes phenotypes
general_rules.numbers: decimal point '.', finite values only; 'inf'/'nan' written in a file are rejected
general_rules.row_shape: every data row has exactly as many fields as the header (ABP-E103 otherwise)

sire.description: sire id or an unknown-parent token (data.unknown_parent_values, default '0', '', 'NA', '.')

dam.description: dam id or an unknown-parent token

rules: parents not listed as animals are added as founders (reported)
no cycles, no self-parenthood, no animal as both sire and dam
parents must be born before offspring when both dates are known

phenotypes.grain: one row = one record (animal x measurement occasion)
phenotypes.primary_key: record_id if declared in data.phenotype_columns.record_id, otherwise the file line

<fixed factor>.required: for records measured on a trait the term applies to

<covariate>.required: for records measured on a trait the term applies to

<iid random-effect column>.required: for records used in the analysis

rules: repeated records of an animal require an iid term on the animal id column
values outside the declared range: error or quarantine (qc.out_of_range)

counted_allele.description: must equal ref or alt; dosages count copies of this allele

genotypes.grain: one row = one animal; one column per marker of the map (any order)

<marker_id>.description: copies of the counted allele; decimals allowed (imputed dosages); missing tokens allowed

outputs.ebv_<trait>.csv: animal, sire, dam, sex, generation, inbreeding, n_records, ebv, pev, sep, reliability, accuracy (empty = not computed)
outputs.ebv_multitrait.csv: animal, pedigree columns, then ebv_/reliability_/sep_/n_records_ per trait
outputs.qc_pedigree.json / qc_phenotypes.json /: QC findings (check, severity, count, examples) and statistics
outputs.qc_excluded_records.csv: reversible list of every record excluded by an approved QC rule
outputs.results.json: all numbers shown in the report
outputs.report.md: breeder-facing report rendered from results.json and manifest.json
